signals.title: Silver Lake leads €350M investment in Italian insurtech Prima
signals.what_changed: Silver Lake led a €350M funding round in Prima, an Italian insurtech company based in Milan, to support technology expansion.

signals.title: EuroGroup Laminations sets IPO range in Milan after Silver Lake backing
signals.what_changed: Italian EV-components supplier EuroGroup Laminations set its IPO price range on the Milan exchange after investment support from Silver Lake.

signals.title: Oaktree becomes owner of Inter Milan after financing default
signals.what_changed: Oaktree Capital Management took ownership of Inter Milan, an Italian Serie A football club based in Milan, after a financing default event.

signals.title: Oaktree supports Inter Milan with capital injection under long-term plan
signals.what_changed: Inter Milan, the Italian club controlled by Oaktree, approved a capital increase to strengthen the balance sheet and support ongoing operations.
